title: Metadata
noAuditBody: The audit appears once a snapshot of this listing is stored.
noKeywordsBody: Track keywords to see how your metadata covers them.
scratchPad: A scratch pad: nothing typed here is saved.
keywordFieldSavedUnder: The keyword field is saved under

coverage.caption: Keyword coverage across {fields}{screenshotText}, with uncovered keywords marked.
coverage.screenshotTextNote: Screenshot text is a weak signal that Apple has not confirmed. It never changes whether a keyword counts as covered.
coverage.unreadScreenshotNote: A dashed circle means the screenshots of that keyword's listing have not been read yet.
coverage.wordsSplitNote: Words split means every word of the keyword is in your listing, but no field holds the whole phrase. The App Store still matches it; the whole phrase in the title or subtitle may rank higher.
coverage.trackedFound: Tracked keywords found in each field
coverage.everyKeywordPresent: Every tracked keyword is in this listing.
coverage.trackedKeywords: {count, plural, one {# tracked keyword} other {# tracked keywords}}

assistant.title: AI drafts
assistant.placeholder: Steer tone or angle, for example: emphasise sleep tracking.
assistant.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select and copy it manually.
assistant.footer: Drafts are suggestions. {product} never writes to the store.

draftLocalization.label: Localization
draftLocalization.hint: Drafts are written in {language}. To fill its keyword field with keywords in another language instead, say so in the instructions.

suggestion.title: Suggested keyword field
suggestion.covered: Every tracked keyword is already covered.

notSearchedTipLabel: Why the store does not search {field}
notSearchedTipSummary: The App Store does not search this field, so words in it do not help you rank. Write it for the people who read your page.
